# Syrian Visual Identity | الهوية البصرية للجمهورية العربية السورية
> Official documentation and design system for the Syrian Visual Identity, preserved and curated for developers and AI coding agents.

- Website: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/
- Repository: https://github.com/sytocode/syrian-visual-identity
- Slogan: انتماءٌ راسخ يتجاوز الحدود | Steadfast Belonging Beyond Borders
- Design System Manual: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/DESIGN.md
- Full LLM Reference: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/llms-full.txt
- Design Tokens CSS: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/tokens.css
- Tailwind Preset: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/syria-preset.js
- WebMCP Manifest: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/mcp.json
- AI Ruleset (.cursorrules): https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/rules/cursorrules.txt

## Official Color Palette
Use these exact color values in all interfaces representing Syria:

### 1. Forest Green (الأخضر الغابي - Primary Brand Color)
- Main / Primary: #054239 | rgb(5, 66, 57) | oklch(0.33 0.08 175) | Tailwind: bg-syria-forest / #054239
- Light: #428177 | rgb(66, 129, 119) | oklch(0.55 0.08 175)
- Deep / Dark: #002623 | rgb(0, 38, 35) | oklch(0.20 0.06 175)

### 2. Golden Wheat (القمح الذهبي - Accent / Secondary Color)
- Accent Gold: #b9a779 | rgb(185, 167, 121) | oklch(0.72 0.08 92) | Tailwind: text-syria-gold / #b9a779
- Muted Gold: #988561 | rgb(152, 133, 97) | oklch(0.61 0.07 90)
- Light Cream: #edebe0 | rgb(237, 235, 224) | oklch(0.93 0.02 95)

### 3. Deep Umber (العنبري الدمشقي)
- Base: #6b1f2a | rgb(107, 31, 42)
- Deep: #4a151e | rgb(74, 21, 30)
- Dark: #260f14 | rgb(38, 15, 20)

### 4. Charcoal & Surface (الفحمي والأرضيات)
- Pure Surface: #ffffff | rgb(255, 255, 255)
- Text Slate: #3d3a3b | rgb(61, 58, 59)
- Dark Canvas: #161616 | rgb(22, 22, 22)

## Syrian Constitutional Flag Specifications
- Aspect Ratio: Exactly 3:2 (36 width by 24 height units).
- Three horizontal equal bands (8 units each):
  1. Top Band: Green (#007A3D or official constitutional green)
  2. Middle Band: White (#FFFFFF)
  3. Bottom Band: Black (#000000)
- Three Red Five-Pointed Stars (#CE1126):
  - Placed horizontally in the middle white band.
  - Centered at horizontal coordinates: 25%, 50%, and 75% of total flag width.
  - Each star points strictly upwards (one tip facing straight up).
  - Scalable Flag SVG Blueprint: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/assets/materials/syrian-flag-proportions.svg

## Typography
- Display / Headline Font: Qomra (خط قمرة) - Official typeface by iWantype.
- Body / Free Web Font: Hayyakum Allah (خط حيّاكم الله) - 4 weights: Light (300), Regular (400), Medium (500), Bold (700).

## WebMCP Quick Tool Discovery
This site supports WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext` / `window.syrianIdentityMCP`):
- `get_color_palette`: Returns all colors and token classes.
- `get_logo`: Returns SVG URLs and vectors.
- `get_flag_specs`: Returns exact SVG geometry and constitutional rules.
- `get_governorate_landmark`: Returns SVG and info for all 14 governorates.
- Manifest endpoint: https://sytocode.github.io/syrian-visual-identity/mcp.json
